title: Japanese museum curator shown UFO footage at Johnson Space Center

tellings.quote: and he was at NASA Johnson Space Center and he said he went to a specific building and they showed him photos of UFOs

plain: A Japanese museum curator named Takano Josen is said to have visited NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, where he was taken to a particular building and shown photos of UFOs. Michels passes this on as something the curator said. If true, it would mean NASA keeps UFO images it has not made public.
